notes: Three taḥwīl branches, each ending «ح» or at محمد بن جعفر, meet at «كلهم عن شعبة» : the tail is written once
«في هذا الإسناد» is a back_reference at the end of the tail, read as the Sunni convention for «بهذا الإسناد»
«يعني ابن الحارث» is an editor gloss, left out; the wording remarks about يحيى بن سعيد's narration are not routes
